tagline: Write with context. Publish with control.
emptyBody: Model setup and focused writing tools arrive in the next implementation phase.
emptyAction: Start with an idea, keep the final word.
onboardingTitle: Three steps to your first draft
onboardingBody: PostMuse stays local until you choose Generate.
onboardingStepProvider: Connect your own AI provider in Settings.
onboardingStepDraft: Add an idea, draft, or local text file.
onboardingStepReview: Generate, edit, and copy. You publish manually.
settingsBody: Your provider settings stay in this browser. PostMuse never receives your key.
creationDefaultsBody: Choose the starting values for the compact X panel and the full Create workspace.
creationDefaultsHint: More drafts use more Provider tokens. The default style is managed in Prompts.
creationDefaultsError: Creation defaults could not be saved.
textProviderSectionBody: Used for posts, replies, threads, and long-form drafts.
imageProviderSectionBody: A separate model and key used only when you request an image.
apiKeyHint: The key is never shown again after saving.
apiKeyReplaceHint: Leave blank to keep the saved key, or enter a new one to replace it.
apiKeyReentryHint: This key was saved before secure Provider binding was added, or the Provider destination changed. Re-enter it once to continue.
storageSessionHint: Safer default. Cleared when Chrome restarts.
storageLocalHint: Persists across restarts. Use only on a trusted device.
baseUrlHint: HTTPS is required. Localhost HTTP is available for development.
baseUrlHttpsOnlyHint: This store build accepts HTTPS Provider URLs only.
temperatureHint: Optional advanced control from 0 (consistent) to 1 (varied). The default works for most people.
samplingModeHint: Provider default is compatible with the widest range of models.
connectionTestNote: Sends fixed synthetic text to your Provider. It uses no draft, history, or custom prompt and may incur a tiny Provider charge.
imageApiKeyHint: Stored separately from the text provider key and never shown again.
imageSettingsNote: A real provider request is sent only when you click Generate image.
privacyDataBody: See what stays in this browser, copy safe diagnostics, or remove local data.
privacyNoBackend: PostMuse has no account, analytics, telemetry, or developer-operated backend.
privacyProviderTransfer: Only Generate sends the shown content directly to the provider you configured.
deleteKeysConfirm: Delete all text and image API keys?
savedKeysDeleted: All saved API keys were deleted.
revokeOriginsConfirm: Remove all optional Provider host permissions granted to PostMuse?
providerAccessRevoked: Provider access was revoked. {count} permissions remain.
resetDataConfirm: Delete settings, prompts, keys, preferences, and history?
dataActionError: The local data action could not be completed.
errorKeyRequired: Add an API key before testing the setup.
errorKeyReentry: Re-enter the API key because its Provider, destination, or storage changed.
errorPermissionRequired: Provider host permission is required for this setup.
errorModelRequired: Choose a model before testing the setup.
errorStyleNotFound: The selected style is hidden or no longer available. Choose another style.
errorInvalidSettings: Check the provider settings and try again.
createBody: Shape a standalone post, reply, quote, thread, or Premium long post. You edit and publish the final version.
sourcePlaceholder: What do you want to say? Add the useful context, rough wording, or an existing draft.
customLengthRangeError: Enter a target between {min} and {max} characters.
configureModelBody: Add a model and API key in Settings. Your draft stays local until you generate.
localDraftNote: Drafts stay in this panel and are not sent until you generate.
providerDisclosure: Generate sends this draft directly to {provider} at {origin}. PostMuse has no server.
sourceRequired: Add an idea, draft, or text file before generating.
fileSizeError: The file is larger than 1 MiB. Choose a smaller file.
sourceLengthError: The source is longer than 100,000 characters. Shorten it before generating.
fileReadError: The text file could not be read.
errorAuthInvalid: The Provider rejected the API key.
errorModelForbidden: This API key cannot access the selected model.
errorModelNotFound: The model or Provider endpoint was not found.
errorEndpointNotFound: The Provider endpoint redirected or could not be used safely.
errorProviderRequestInvalid: The Provider rejected these request parameters.
errorRateLimited: The Provider rate limit or quota was reached.
errorTimeout: The Provider took too long to respond.
errorNetwork: The Provider could not be reached.
errorContentRejected: The Provider declined to generate this content.
errorOutputInvalid: The Provider returned an unreadable response.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
historySaveError: The result is ready, but it could not be saved to local history.
rawFallbackNotice: The Provider did not return valid structured JSON. The original text is preserved for editing and copying.
partialResultNotice: The Provider returned fewer usable items than requested. Available drafts are preserved.
lengthBelowTarget: One or more drafts are shorter than the selected range.
lengthAboveTarget: One or more drafts are longer than the selected range.
tokenBudgetWarning: This draft may be truncated: the profile limit is {current} tokens; about {recommended} is recommended for the selected length and item count. Generation is still allowed.
longPostNotice: Premium availability and final length are determined by your X account. This is a plain-text long post, not an X Article.
standaloneImageBody: Describe the image you want. No text draft is required.
imageDescriptionHint: Describe the subject, scene, composition, colors, and mood you want.
imageGeneratorBody: Review the prompt before sending it to your configured image provider.
imageOpenAI2KLocalNotice: OpenAI returns a native image that PostMuse scales locally to the selected 2K canvas.
imageIncludeText: Allow short text inside the image
imagePromptHint: The selected draft is included as untrusted reference material. Edit freely before generating.
imageSetupRequired: Set up an image provider before generating.
imageProviderDisclosure: This prompt is sent directly to {provider} at {origin}.
promptsBody: Edit built-in styles or add your own. Only this style layer changes; PostMuse keeps the output format and safety rules separate.
writingProfileBody: Optionally describe who you are and the perspective that should remain consistent across styles.
writingProfilePlaceholder:
Example only — start typing to replace it.

I am an independent developer focused on AI products and practical tools.
I write directly and concretely, often using firsthand product examples.
I value user outcomes and avoid hype, empty inspiration, and exaggerated claims.
My posts should sound thoughtful, restrained, and genuinely personal.
writingProfileHint: The example is never saved or sent. Only text you enter and save is added to generation requests.
writingProfileSaveError: The writing profile could not be saved.
promptLayerNote: Describe voice, structure, rhythm, and formatting preferences. Source material and output rules are added separately during generation.
restoreAllBody: Removes built-in edits and unhides all built-in styles. Custom styles are kept.
promptFieldsRequired: Enter both a display name and style instructions.
promptLoadError: The local style library could not be loaded.
promptSaveError: The style change could not be saved. Try again.
historyBody: Search, edit, copy, or reuse your last 100 generated results. Everything stays in this browser.
historyEnabledBody: Structured results are saved automatically. Raw fallback text requires confirmation.
historyDisabledNote: New results will not be saved. Existing history remains available.
historySearchPlaceholder: Search source ideas and generated text
historyEmptyBody: Generate a structured result, or explicitly save a raw fallback result.
historyLoadError: Local history could not be loaded.
historyActionError: The history change could not be completed. Try again.
inlineContextDisclosure: Adds only the related post already visible on X.
inlineSetupTitle: Set up a text provider first
inlineSetupBody: Open PostMuse, add a model and API key, then return to this post.
inlineExtractionError: PostMuse could not safely read this post. Open the side panel to write from scratch.
inlineRuntimeError: PostMuse could not complete this request. Check Settings or copy the post into the side panel.
inlinePermissionError: Provider access is not enabled. Test the setup in PostMuse Settings first.
inlineHistorySyncWarning: The draft is ready, but local history could not be updated.
inlineOpenError: The side panel could not be opened. Use the toolbar icon instead.
